strings: Spotting m_c stumbling over something on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} right side, r_c0 brings {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to the medicine cat den, where it becomes clear that eye isn't working as normal.
m_c has become good at not letting things approaching on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} bad side startle {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, except it turns out that's not a normal universal experience for a kitten to have.
